title: Bar Salts Pineapple Ice Flavour Concentrate 10ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Pineapple Ice flavour concentrate blends the tropical sweetness of pineapple with a refreshing icy finish. This 10ml concentrate offers a taste of summer with every vape, ideal for those looking to mix a custom e-liquid with a cool, fruity twist. Perfect for DIY enthusiasts, this concentrate allows for a tailored vaping experience. Add your preferred nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to achieve the desired strength and texture, creating a unique and personal vape juice. Designed for vapers who enjoy crafting their blends, this 100% PG concentrate provides the foundation for a personalized vape experience. Adjust the nicotine level and VG/PG ratios to your liking by adding nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to achieve the perfect balance. Mix this concentrate with a VG/PG base of your choice and add nicotine shots as desired to achieve your perfect vape, with recommended dilution rates between 15-20% to suit your taste. Produced in the UK, this high-quality concentrate is designed for optimal flavour accuracy and mixing versatility. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
